R_boundedIntRule_retest.purpose: Does the ORIGINAL boundedIntRule shape ([1-9] [0-9]{0,3}, no digit-width alternation) parse under a clean, underscore-free name?

S1_changesNotes.purpose: Fire changesNotes (was changes_notes, one of Q1b's three flagged-but-untested coaching fields) in its real modify_task/changes context.
S1_changesNotes.grammar:
root ::= "{\"action\":\"modify_task\",\"task_id\":\"1\",\"changes\":" changes "}"
changes ::= "{\"duration_minutes\":null,\"context_tags\":null,\"energy\":null,\"approach_notes\":" changesNotes "}"
changesNotes ::= "null" | "\"" jchar{1,200} "\""
jchar ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F] | "\\" (["\\/bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})

S2_reason120.purpose: Fire reason120 (already underscore-free) in its real eliminate_task context, to confirm the whole union still compiles now that its sibling rules are de-underscored.

S3_condition120.purpose: Fire condition120 in its real until_condition/untilCondition context (renamed), nested inside defer_task's until union - the deepest of the three flagged coaching fields.
S3_condition120.grammar:
root ::= "{\"action\":\"defer_task\",\"task_id\":\"1\",\"until\":" until "}"
until ::= untilCondition
untilCondition ::= "{\"condition\":" condition120 "}"
condition120 ::= "\"" jchar{1,120} "\""
jchar ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F] | "\\" (["\\/bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})

T_full_due_union.purpose: Full due union (dueOnDate/dueInDays/dueWeekday, daysInt as the plain digit-count form, date self-quoting), byte-for-byte the real post-rename task_extraction.v1.gbnf shape.
T_full_due_union.grammar:
root ::= "{\"title\":" title ",\"due\":" due "}"
title ::= "\"" jchar{1,80} "\""
due ::= "null" | dueOnDate | dueInDays | dueWeekday
dueOnDate ::= "{\"kind\":\"on_date\",\"date\":" date "}"
date ::= "\"" jchar{1,10} "\""
dueInDays ::= "{\"kind\":\"in_days\",\"days\":" daysInt "}"
daysInt ::= [1-9] [0-9]{0,2}
dueWeekday ::= "{\"kind\":\"weekday\",\"day\":" weekday ",\"which\":" which "}"
which ::= "\"this\"" | "\"next\""
weekday ::= "\"monday\"" | "\"tuesday\"" | "\"wednesday\"" | "\"thursday\"" | "\"friday\"" | "\"saturday\"" | "\"sunday\""
jchar ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F] | "\\" (["\\/bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
T_full_due_union.note: Grammar parsed cleanly (PASS = no parse error). The model chose the due:null branch despite a date in the prompt rather than dueOnDate - a model-quality/prompting artifact (this probe has no system prompt grounding date interpretation, unlike Stage 2's fixtures), not a grammar defect.
